sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Viper Napuatzi is the Act 3 Legion Blockade boss in Utzaal. She does not just deal Chaos — she layers Fire and Chaos rain, a spear barrage, and a shrinking arena that boxes you in.
calloutDetail: The arena shrinks in steps as the fight goes on; the safe space gets smaller, so positioning matters more than raw damage.
After the 0.5.0 changes, a Flask charge is restored during the constriction window — use it, do not panic.
Rolling through the spear barrage gaps is the intended counter; rolling to the outer edge can trap you outside the fight.

sections.title: Top search questions: entry, damage, recovery

items.question: Is Viper only a Chaos boss?
answer: No. Her rain attacks split into Fire meteors and Chaos meteors, and her Poison Spear Totem applies Poison. Plan for all three, not just Chaos Resistance.

items.question: What is Armed vs Unarmed?
answer: These are attack states, not separate phases. Armed she throws spear barrages and melee combos; Unarmed she leans on rain and bolt casts. Both happen across the same fight.

items.question: Why does the arena keep getting smaller?
answer: The Legion pushes inward in steps tied to her barrage cycles. It is intended pressure, not a bug — but rolling out of the line can desync you from the arena.

items.question: Do I recover Flasks during the fight?
answer: Yes, the current version restores Flask charges during the constriction window (changed in 0.5.0). Use the breathing room instead of burning Flasks early.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Viper Napuatzi is the Act 3 Legion Blockade boss in Utzaal. She is a pressure fight: she peppers the arena with Fire and Chaos rain, sends rows of spears across the field, and slowly shrinks the playable space with her Legion.

The fight is not about a single one-shot mechanic. It is about surviving the attrition while the arena closes in. Players who treat it like a pure Chaos check fail because the Fire meteors and Poison totems bleed them down between the big hits.
bullets: Not a single-damage-type boss — prepare Chaos, Fire and Poison mitigation.
The shrinking arena is the defining pressure, not a side effect.
A Flask recovery window exists in the current version — use it.

sections.title: Arena Constriction Timeline
paragraphs: The arena starts at full size, then contracts in steps synced to Viper's spear barrage cycles. Each contraction reduces safe space and forces melee and ranged into the same lane.
After the 0.5.0 changes a Flask charge is restored during the constriction window. This is the intended recovery beat — do not waste Flasks before it, and do not roll toward the closing wall.
bullets: Initial full area → first spear barrage → Legion pushes in.
Flask recovery window opens during the push.
Second push → final small arena with overlapping rain.
Rolling to the outer edge can desync you from the fight (known edge case).

phases.label: Phase 1 — Full Arena (100%–~50%)
notes: Viper uses spear barrages, Fire meteors and Poison totems while the arena is still open.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Constriction (~50%–0%)
phases.trigger: At low HP the Legion pushes in.
notes: Arena shrinks in steps; Flask recovery window opens; Chaos meteors grow larger and overlap Fire rain.

attacks.name: Spear Barrage
telegraph: Soldiers line up and launch a wall of spears across the arena.
responses: Roll through the gaps in the spear wall, or time a roll between volleys.
notes: Rolling to the outer edge can desync you from the arena.
commonMistakes: Rolling to the arena edge and getting stuck outside

attacks.name: Fire Meteors
telegraph: Viper rises and marks several small impact zones.
responses: Walk into a zone that already landed; the ground is safe after impact.
notes: Distinct from Chaos rain by orange color and smaller zones.
commonMistakes: Hugging the wall with no room to move

attacks.name: Chaos Meteors
telegraph: Larger purple circling zones appear after the Fire meteors.
responses: Leave the stacked overlap early; do not stand in both rains.
notes: Grows larger in Phase 2 and overlaps Fire rain.
commonMistakes: Watching Viper instead of the ground

attacks.name: Chaos Bolts
telegraph: Rapid successive purple bolts aimed at your position.
responses: Stafe sideways or roll; do not backroll repeatedly into a corner.

attacks.name: Poison Spear Totem
telegraph: A totem spawns and channels Poison.
responses: Destroy it quickly; Poison stacks punish prolonged fights.
notes: Source of the Poison damage type.

attacks.name: Viper Spark
responses: Step to her side or behind during the wind-up.
notes: Short-range; melee must respect the wind-up.

sections.title: Spear Barrage Guide
paragraphs: The Spear Barrage is the signature pressure attack. Soldiers line up and launch a wall of spears; the wall has gaps you roll through. The mistake most players make is rolling outward toward the closing Legion wall, which can leave you outside the fight entirely.
Treat each barrage as a timing puzzle: watch the launch, count the volleys, and roll through a known gap rather than away from the boss.
bullets: Gaps exist — roll through, do not roll away.
Do not roll to the outer edge during constriction.
Melee can use the barrage downtime to commit.

sections.title: Flask Recovery Window
paragraphs: Since 0.5.0, a Flask charge is restored during the constriction window. This is the designed recovery beat of the fight: the arena pushes in, Viper briefly eases her offense, and you get a charge back.
Plan your resource use around it. Burning all Flasks in Phase 1 leaves you exposed when the Chaos meteors grow in Phase 2.
bullets: Restored Flask charge = use it during the push.
Do not pre-spend Flasks before the window.
Pair the window with a damage burst if safe.

items.label: Capped Chaos Resistance
items.why: Her Chaos meteors and bolts are the deadliest sustained damage.
items.fix: Chaos rolls, a Chaos charm, or a corrupted item with chaos res.

items.label: Fire and Poison mitigation
checks: Some Fire res and Poison immunity or cleansing.
items.why: Fire meteors and Poison totems chip you between big hits.
items.fix: Fire res rolls; a way to clear or avoid Poison.

items.label: Movement speed
items.why: The shrinking arena forces constant repositioning.
items.fix: Movement-speed suffix or a movement skill.

items.label: Flask charges
items.why: The fight is long; the recovery window is not enough alone.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Chaos Resistance is the priority, but the fight also tests mobility. The shrinking arena punishes any build that must stand still to deal damage.
Ranged builds can kite the rain if they respect the closing wall; melee must use barrage downtime to commit and retreat before the Chaos meteors grow.
bullets: Melee: commit during barrage downtime, retreat before meteors grow.
Ranged: kite inward as the arena shrinks, never to the wall.
Minion: bodies can body-block spears but die to Chaos rain.
Avoid low-mobility towers — the constriction will corner you.

entries.question: I rolled to the edge and got stuck outside the fight
summary: Multiple players report rolling outward during constriction and ending up outside the arena with no way to progress.
editorialAnalysis: This is a known edge case, not intended difficulty. The fix is to stay inside the closing wall.
officialAnswer: Respawn at checkpoint to reset the instance; do not roll to the outer edge.

entries.question: Why do I die to Chaos so fast
summary: Forum posts note Chaos meteors overlap Fire rain in Phase 2, doubling pressure.
editorialAnalysis: Our read: cap Chaos res and leave the overlap early; the damage is telegraphed, not a one-shot.
officialAnswer: Cap Chaos Resistance and respect both rains; it is telegraphed damage.

problems.symptom: I got stuck outside the arena after rolling
directAnswer: Respawn at checkpoint to reset the instance; stay inside the closing wall next time.
checks: Did you roll to the outer edge?

problems.symptom: Chaos damage melts me in Phase 2
directAnswer: Cap Chaos res and leave the Fire+Chaos overlap early; the meteors are telegraphed.
checks: Are you standing in both rains?

problems.symptom: The fight drags and Poison stacks kill me
directAnswer: Destroy the Poison Spear Totem fast; Poison is the long-fight tax.
